2607.24720.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
2607.24720.paper_summary: Multi-turn long-horizon planning is critical for foundation model agents, yet how to fundamentally improve it remains unclear. Existing models are trained on uncontrollable and opaque Internet data, making it difficult to identify how planning ability is acquired, shaped, and integrated. To address this challenge, we introduce a unified and controlled multi-turn environment that enables precise control. It allows systematically study long-horizon planning across three stages. (1) Planning ability acquisition during pre-training. We study data format, distribution, and quality. Explicit world model construction through CoT state transition modeling yields stronger long-horizon generalization. Atomic skills alone are insufficient for compositional generalization, whereas a litte long-horizon data works. Moreover, suboptimal trajectories severely impair performance because errors amplify over long horizons. (2) Planning ability shaping via GRPO and OPD post-training. Through mutual information, we distinguish general planning patterns from task-specific planning knowledge. For planning patterns, we identify three application regions of post-training: unnecessary, effective, and unsupported. OPD has a broader effective region than GRPO under low-quality and long-horizon settings, as it provides more consistent update directions. For planning knowledge, distilling unseen procedures from a teacher with different knowledge may impair student's prior world modeling without fully establishing new knowledge. (3) Planning ability integration through MOPD post-training. We show that multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates capabilities by converging to shared planning-pattern across environments. Compatible patterns enable cross-environment generalization, partially shared patterns support continual learning, while completely conflicting patterns cause severe interference.
2607.24720.paper_summary_zh: 多回合長期規劃對於基礎模型代理至關重要，但如何根本性地改善它仍然不清楚。現有模型是在不可控且不透明的互聯網數據上訓練的，這使得識別規劃能力是如何獲得、塑造和整合的變得困難。為了解決這一挑戰，我們引入了一個統一且可控的多回合環境，能夠實現精確控制。它允許系統性地研究三個階段的長期規劃。(1) 在預訓練期間獲得規劃能力。我們研究數據格式、分佈和質量。通過CoT狀態轉換建模明確構建世界模型，能夠產生更強的長期泛化。僅依賴原子技能不足以實現組合泛化，而少量的長期數據則有效。此外，次優軌跡會嚴重損害性能，因為錯誤在長期中會放大。(2) 通過GRPO和OPD後訓練塑造規劃能力。通過互信息，我們區分一般規劃模式與特定任務的規劃知識。對於規劃模式，我們確定了後訓練的三個應用區域：不必要的、有效的和不支持的。在低質量和長期設置下，OPD的有效區域比GRPO更廣，因為它提供了更一致的更新方向。對於規劃知識，從擁有不同知識的教師那裡提煉未見程序可能會損害學生先前的世界建模，而未能完全建立新知識。(3) 通過MOPD後訓練整合規劃能力。我們展示了多教師在線蒸餾（MOPD）通過在環境之間收斂到共享規劃模式來整合能力。兼容的模式使跨環境泛化成為可能，部分共享的模式支持持續學習，而完全衝突的模式則會造成嚴重干擾。
